name: Compact Box (CB)
definition: A preprocessing optimization for rasterization that reduces the number of Gaussian-tile pairs by tightening the effective support region of 2D Gaussians, eliminating unnecessary pairs where the Gaussian has negligible impact on pixels within a tile.
summary: Compact Box is a rasterization optimization that tightens 2D Gaussian support regions using a scaling factor to eliminate negligible Gaussian-tile pairs, reducing computational redundancy beyond standard methods.
